scope_change: Only classify one evidenced takeoff magnetic heading realignment and explicitly choose task yaw after it. No estimator, navigator, controller, reset-counter or nu modifications. No retroactive acceptance changes.

reference_policy.before_arm: Preserve immutable original xyz, heading, heading counter, ref_timestamp/ref_lat/ref_lon/ref_alt and all p/v reset counters. Height remains ground_z minus local z; global altitude target uses the same pre-arm ref_alt.
reference_policy.heading_exception_phase: TAKEOFF_PREPARATION only: armed, airborne, no ground contact, actual AUTO_TAKEOFF or POSCTL, before any DO_REPOSITION/AUTO_LOITER/excitation/observation
reference_policy.heading_delta_limit_basis: New conservative engineering admission cap, one quarter of unchanged 20deg yaw envelope; not a theoretical bound or held-out estimate. Chosen after historical PID diagnostic knowledge; disclose this development use.
reference_policy.height_limit_basis: Broad preparation envelope, not an exact reproduction of private delayed terrain>1.5m test. dist_bottom_valid=false is not proof of a valid range observation.

evidence.mag_aligned_in_flight: same primary 0->1; yaw_align true; not mag_fault, mag_field_disturbed, emergency reset, EV/GPS yaw takeover or filter fault
evidence.metadata_max_age_scope: Periodic estimator_status only; do not apply 0.5s to all metadata topics.
evidence.events_freshness: estimator_event_flags is event-only, no periodic heartbeat. Require pre-arm last event/counter snapshot and uninterrupted subscription/decoded history, contiguous information/warning change counters for new messages, no forbidden events. An old last event is not a new reset nor automatically stale failure; a missing topic or unobservable event interval is not zero. Do not force extra EKF publications.
evidence.metadata_age_basis: Pinned sources: estimator_status requested at 200ms logger interval; selector/status_flags publish about 1Hz or on change; events publish only on events. Separate 0.5/1.2s engineering guards, not claimed common sample rates.
evidence.pending: On first candidate, inhibit height command/admission while awaiting asynchronous alignment evidence for <=0.5s. Missing/late/contradictory evidence fails; do not silently accept immediately.
evidence.record: Original counters/delta/time/primary/alignment flags, pending and confirmation timestamps, actual status/land and controller diagnostics; no zero replacement for missing fields. No Gazebo truth.

reference_policy.after_exception: Any second heading event, including counter jump or estimator switch, fails. No heading changes after task_yaw_freeze through landing/disarm. Do not exempt landing resets.

task_yaw_policy.precondition: Confirmed first in-air alignment; primary healthy/aligned; no pending event; unchanged reference and p/v counters; armed airborne POSCTL, no faults. If no admissible alignment arrives, timeout; do not command one or force the flag.
task_yaw_policy.quiet_rule: Continuously stable counters/primary and valid estimates/targets in POSCTL for >=1s before height command; no heading reset anywhere in this interval.
task_yaw_policy.freeze: Once only: task_yaw=wrap_pi(latest valid measured local heading) after quiet gate, record timestamp/sample/counters and existing trajectory yaw. Original prearm_heading is retained, never overwritten. This changes experimental task heading from pre-arm to post-alignment convention; not a claim of identical prearm physical direction.
task_yaw_policy.command: One original navigator DO_REPOSITION with param4=task_yaw radians for this pinned receiver; no external attitude/rate/trajectory publisher. Do not add delta_heading again to this fresh post-alignment value.
task_yaw_policy.no_rebase: Neither ground xyz nor global reference is re-frozen. Task yaw cannot track measurements or be recaptured after command. Later reset always fails.
task_yaw_policy.existing_compensation: Preserve FlightTask/MPC/attitude reset handling. Same-timestamp target is treated fresh by MPC; older cache may receive delta once. Do not assume all published targets jump by delta or that internal attitude target is fully logged.

timing.preparation_timeout_scope: Original takeoff plus alignment confirmation, POSCTL quiet interval, height command/ACK and 3s height entry; no extra timeout extension.
timing.after_loiter: Unchanged 12s settle, height ready by gate+10s, continuous 3s entry, 32s waveform fully within 60s observation. Preparation cannot restart excitation clock or shift windows.

proposed_next_batch.order: three fresh paired development seeds; each PID then ESTA; pair gate before next pair
